content.tex: A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 to 6)
CHANGING THE ORDER OF OPERATIONS (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This investigation is about the results of two calculations when you change the order of operations.
Each calculation uses three integers, \(x\) , \(y\) and \(z\) .
Calculation 1 Calculation 2
Add \(y\) and \(z\) . Multiply \(y\) and \(z\) . Multiply the answer by \(x\) . Add the answer to \(x\) .
Example
\(x = 3\quad y = 5\quad z = 7\)
Calculation 1 Calculation 2
\(y+z = 5+7 = 12\quad y\times z = 5\times 7 = 35\) \(12\times x = 12\times 3 = 36\quad 35+x = 35+3 = 38\) Result \(= 36\) Result \(= 38\)
